text_block_list.text:
There are three racers getting a lot of
attention in
this year's Classic Triple
Crown tour.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ, Нарита Таисин, and
Winning
Ticket.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As they've been rivals since before their
debuts,
people have given them a
special nickname.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
So it's finally time for BNW's first Triple
Crown
showdown! I wonder who's gonna
win!
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
It's gotta be Taishin. Her final sprint last
time was
amazing.
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text:
Didn't you see Бива Хаяхидэ in the
junior races?
The way she accelerates
from the get-go is
something else!
text_block_list.name: Fan C

text_block_list.text:
But you gotta admit Уиннинг Тикит is
great too.
Her power in the final stretch
is the best.
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
While the expectations for their match
are
running high, the racers themselves
are quietly
making their way through the
tunnel entrance.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ALL RIGHT! I'm gonna go all out!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: I'll be the one to break ahead and win!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I've calculated my formula to win. All
that's left is
to get the final result.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
(I gotta win this and prove myself ahead
of the
Derby!)
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
(But then again, that goes for Taishin
and
Hayahide too!)
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Wooo! I'll see you two later!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит dashes off toward the
track,
where the crowd is abuzz with
high expectations.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
